description: Return the betslipdoctor.ai link (linkUrl) where the customer upgrades or manages a card subscription. plan is the plan they want (starter, pro, elite, heavy_199, heavy_499, heavy_999, heavy_1999 or enterprise; default the next plan up), interval month or year (default month). Card subscribers at any tier get the account page link. The customer opens the link, signs in with this same account and makes changes there; this tool never charges, starts a payment or changes the plan.
name: start_plan_upgrade
title: Get a plan upgrade link
